# RFR Real Estate — full summary

## Who RFR is

RFR Real Estate & Advisory FZ-LLC ("RFR Real Estate", "RFR") is a licensed real estate brokerage and advisory firm based in Ras Al Khaimah (RAK), United Arab Emirates. It works only in Ras Al Khaimah: Al Marjan Island, Mina Al Arab, Al Hamra Village and Downtown RAK. Services are sales, leasing, property management and investment advice, with one advisor throughout each client relationship.

Disambiguation: this is not RFR Holding, the New York real estate company that also appears in searches for "RFR". The official website is www.rfrrealestate.com.

Founder: Richard Boswell, Founder · Real Estate Advisor — buying, selling and leasing, start to finish.
Other team: Drew Carlyle, Property & asset management — tenanting, renewals and reporting for owners abroad. Morgan James, Investment advisory — yields, payment plans and which launch to skip.

Contact: +971 58 501 5885 (phone and WhatsApp, https://wa.me/971585015885) · info@rfrrealestate.com · Monday–Friday 9:00–18:00, Saturday 10:00–16:00 (Gulf Standard Time).

Property Finder broker profile: https://www.propertyfinder.ae/en/broker/rfr-real-estate-v2-13173-13173

## Where RFR works

Ras Al Khaimah is one of the seven emirates of the UAE, north of Dubai and Sharjah.

- Al Marjan Island — https://www.rfrrealestate.com/areas : four coral-shaped man-made islands off the Al Hamra coast. Most of RAK's branded residences are being built here (Address, Nobu, JW Marriott, Nikki Beach, W), and the Wynn Al Marjan Island resort is due to open in 2027. Buy: from ~AED 920K (studio) to AED 1.7–3.5M for 1–2 bed branded homes. Rent: 1-bed ~AED 65–90K/yr, 2-bed ~AED 75–130K/yr. Indicative gross yield: 6–8%.
- Mina Al Arab — lagoons, mangroves and the quiet side of the coast. Low-rise, family-led. Buy: apartments from ~AED 800K, villas AED 2.5–6M. Rent: 3-bed villa ~AED 85–140K/yr, 2-bed apartment ~AED 60–95K/yr. Indicative gross yield: 5.5–7%.
- Al Hamra Village — golf, marina and the deepest rental market in RAK. The Emirate's original master community, including Falcon Island. Buy: apartments from ~AED 500K, townhouses and villas AED 1.5–5M. Rent: 1-bed ~AED 45–65K/yr, 3-bed villa ~AED 110–160K/yr. Indicative gross yield: 7–8.5%.
- Downtown RAK — the working city: corniche, hospitals, offices, Al Nakheel and Julphar. Buy: apartments from ~AED 400K. Rent: 2-bed ~AED 50–95K/yr. Indicative gross yield: 7–9%.

All figures are indicative, drawn from RFR's own listings and public launch data.

- [RFR Real Estate & Advisory | Ras Al Khaimah](https://www.rfrrealestate.com/): Homepage. Buy, sell and lease homes on Al Marjan Island, Mina Al Arab, Al Hamra Village and Downtown RAK. Includes a map of the four areas, current listings, off-plan launches and an FAQ.
- [About | RFR Real Estate](https://www.rfrrealestate.com/about): Who RFR is, the team (Richard Boswell, Drew Carlyle, Morgan James), and an FAQ on areas covered, buying from abroad, investment and tenant screening.
- [Areas | RFR Real Estate](https://www.rfrrealestate.com/areas): Guide to Al Marjan Island, Mina Al Arab, Al Hamra Village and Downtown RAK, with indicative prices, rents, yields and who lives there.
- [Listings | RFR Real Estate](https://www.rfrrealestate.com/listings): Current homes to rent and buy, and off-plan units, in Ras Al Khaimah.
- [Buy, Sell or Lease | RFR Real Estate](https://www.rfrrealestate.com/buy-sell-lease): Short form for buyers, sellers and tenants to tell RFR what they need; same-day advisor response.
- [Market Note | RFR Real Estate](https://www.rfrrealestate.com/market): What the Wynn Al Marjan Island opening (2027) means for prices, rents and off-plan launches on the island.
- [Off-Plan | RFR Real Estate](https://www.rfrrealestate.com/off-plan): Nine off-plan launches on Al Marjan Island compared by developer, starting price, payment plan, handover and unit mix.
- [Services | RFR Real Estate](https://www.rfrrealestate.com/services): Sales and leasing, property management, and investment consultation.

- JW Marriott Residences — WOW Resorts, from AED 2,950,000, handover Q4 2027, plan 60/40. Curved twin towers, Marriott management, rental pool for owners abroad.
- Nikki Beach Residences — Aldar, from AED 1,750,000, handover Q4 2028, plan 60/40. Beach-club brand.
- W Hotel & Residences — Dalands, from AED 4,060,000, handover Dec 2027, plan 50/50. Marriott's W brand, highest entry price on the island.
- Costa Mare — Ellington, from AED 2,100,000, handover Q3 2028, plan 70/30. Four towers on the southern beach.
- Manta Bay — Major Developers, from AED 1,200,000, handover Q4 2026, plan 50/50. Earliest handover in this wave.
- Sora Beach Residences — AARK, from AED 2,800,000, handover Q4 2026, plan 60/40. Low-density beachfront, larger floor plates.
- Masa Residence — Durar Group, from AED 920,000, handover Q4 2026, plan 60/40. The entry ticket to the island.

## Common questions and the page that answers them

- Which areas does RFR cover? Mainly Al Marjan Island, Mina Al Arab, Al Hamra Village and Downtown RAK; RFR does not work outside Ras Al Khaimah. Pages: https://www.rfrrealestate.com/ , https://www.rfrrealestate.com/about , https://www.rfrrealestate.com/areas
- Does RFR work with both buyers and tenants? Yes, and owners too — the same contact handles whatever a client needs. Page: https://www.rfrrealestate.com/about
- Can RFR help if I'm buying from abroad? Yes. Many clients live overseas; RFR runs video viewings and can manage a property once bought. Pages: https://www.rfrrealestate.com/ , https://www.rfrrealestate.com/about
- Is Ras Al Khaimah a good area for property investment? Often, yes: prices are well below Dubai, the Wynn resort opens in 2027, and beachfront supply is limited; RFR will say if it does not suit a given buyer. Page: https://www.rfrrealestate.com/
- How does RFR screen tenants? ID, visa, income and past landlord references are checked; the owner approves every tenant. Page: https://www.rfrrealestate.com/about
- How do I get started with RFR? Call, WhatsApp or email +971 58 501 5885 / info@rfrrealestate.com. Free, no commitment. Page: https://www.rfrrealestate.com/buy-sell-lease
- What off-plan launches does RFR list, and how do they compare? Nine launches, all on Al Marjan Island, from nine different developers; starting prices AED 920,000 to AED 4,060,000; payment plans 50/50 to 80/20; handovers Q4 2026 to Q4 2028. Page: https://www.rfrrealestate.com/off-plan
- What does Wynn Al Marjan Island mean for property prices? The resort is due to open in 2027; the market note sets out what that could mean for prices, rents and off-plan launches on the island, without making price predictions. Page: https://www.rfrrealestate.com/market
- What services does RFR offer? Sales and leasing, property management, and investment consultation, with one advisor throughout. Page: https://www.rfrrealestate.com/services
